'''''Errant Trader''''' was an [[Ithorian Herdship]].

==Characteristics==
''Errant Trader'' was similar to almost every other [[Ithorian Herdship]], being a huge flattened ball which was designed to simulate the jungles of [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] homeworld, in a space-worthy vessel.

==History==
''Errant Trader'' kept a regular schedule through the busy systems of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], notably [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]], [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]].
